scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace=backend & npm run dev --workspace=frontend
scripts.dev:desktop: npm run build && npm run dev --workspace=desktop
scripts.package:linux: npm run build && node scripts/prepare-desktop-runtime.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --linux AppImage deb --publish never
scripts.package:mac: npm run build && node scripts/prepare-desktop-runtime.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --mac dmg zip --x64 --arm64 --publish never
scripts.package:win: npm run build && node scripts/prepare-desktop-runtime.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --win nsis --publish never
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=backend && npm run build --workspace=frontend && npm run build --workspace=desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=backend && npm run typecheck --workspace=frontend && npm run typecheck --workspace=desktop
scripts.security:prepackage: npm run validate:toolchain && npm run validate:dependencies && npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high && npm audit --audit-level=high && npm run typecheck && npm test --workspace=backend && npm test --workspace=frontend && npm run build
